```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

process_df <- function(df) {
  df = df[df$duration != 0, ]

  p50    <- quantile(df$duration, probs = 0.50)
  p95    <- quantile(df$duration, probs = 0.95)
  p99    <- quantile(df$duration, probs = 0.99)
  p999    <- quantile(df$duration, probs = 0.999)
  p9999    <- quantile(df$duration, probs = 0.9999)
  p100   <- quantile(df$duration, probs = 1)

  df$start_timestamp = df$end_timestamp - df$duration
  df$p50   <- p50
  df$p95   <- p95
  df$p99   <- p99
  df$p999  <- p999
  df$p9999 <- p9999
  df$p100  <- p100

  return(df)
}

rm_smallsample_functions <- function(df) {
  # Return the sub_df if sub_df has more than 1000 rows, otherwise NULL
  if (nrow(df) > 40000) {
    df$rows <- nrow(df)
    return(df)
  } else {
    return(NULL)
  }
  return(df)
}
```

```{r}
start_time <- Sys.time()
data_path = "/Users/davidquaresma/Desktop/repos/faas-simulator/azure/"

file_name = "AzureFunctionsInvocationTraceForTwoWeeksJan2021"
#file_name = "constante-constante_with_tail"

inv2021 = read.csv(paste(data_path, file_name, ".csv", sep=""), header = TRUE)

# Split the inv2021 dataframe by values in func and apply filter_functions to each sub-dataframe
inv2021_split <- lapply(split(inv2021, inv2021$func), rm_smallsample_functions)
# Remove null entries in inv2021_split
inv2021_split_nonull <- inv2021_split[!sapply(inv2021_split, is.null)]
# Add percentiles, mu and sigma values
inv2021_split_processed <- lapply(inv2021_split_nonull, process_df)

# Merge data  
inv2021_merged = do.call(rbind, inv2021_split_processed)
inv2021_merged = data.frame(
  app = inv2021_merged$app,
  func = inv2021_merged$func,
  rows = inv2021_merged$rows,
  start_timestamp = inv2021_merged$start_timestamp,
  duration = inv2021_merged$duration,
  end_timestamp = inv2021_merged$end_timestamp,

  p50 = inv2021_merged$p50,
  p95 = inv2021_merged$p95,
  p99 = inv2021_merged$p99,
  p999 = inv2021_merged$p999,
  p9999 = inv2021_merged$p9999,
  p100 = inv2021_merged$p100
)

# sort by start_timestamp
inv2021_merged = select(
  inv2021_merged[order(inv2021_merged$start_timestamp),], 
  app, func, rows,
  start_timestamp, duration, end_timestamp,
  p50, p95, p99, p999, p9999, p100
)

# save processed data
write.csv(inv2021_merged, file = paste(data_path, file_name, "-final.csv", sep=""), row.names = FALSE)

end_time <- Sys.time()
duration <- as.numeric(end_time - start_time, units = "secs")
duration
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
plot_unified_hist_facets_auto <- function(function_trace, function_merge_trace, title) {
  # Calcula p95, p99 e p100 automaticamente
  p95_original = quantile(function_trace, probs = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
  p95_treated  = quantile(function_merge_trace, probs = 0.95, na.rm = TRUE)
  p999_original = quantile(function_trace, probs = 0.999, na.rm = TRUE)
  p999_treated  = quantile(function_merge_trace, probs = 0.999, na.rm = TRUE)
  p100_original = quantile(function_trace, probs = 1.0, na.rm = TRUE)  # Maximum value
  p100_treated  = quantile(function_merge_trace, probs = 1.0, na.rm = TRUE)  # Maximum value
  
  # Prepare data with 4 different traces
  data_combined <- data.frame(
    duration = c(function_trace, 
                 function_trace[function_trace <= p95_original], 
                 function_merge_trace,
                 function_merge_trace[function_merge_trace <= p95_treated]),
    type = factor(c(rep("Original trace", length(function_trace)),
                    rep("Original truncated at p95", length(function_trace[function_trace <= p95_original])),
                    rep("Treated trace", length(function_merge_trace)),
                    rep("Treated truncated at p95", length(function_merge_trace[function_merge_trace <= p95_treated]))),
                  levels = c("Original trace", "Original truncated at p95", 
                            "Treated trace", "Treated truncated at p95"))
  )
  
  # Create color mapping for facets
  colors_mapping <- c("Original trace" = "#FF6B6B",           # Light red
                      "Original truncated at p95" = "#CC0000", # Dark red
                      "Treated trace" = "#4ECDC4",             # Light teal
                      "Treated truncated at p95" = "#006B5B")  # Dark teal
  
  # Create the plot
  ggplot(data_combined, aes(x = duration, fill = type)) +
    geom_histogram(alpha = 0.8, bins = 30) +
    facet_wrap(~type, scales = "free", nrow = 2, ncol = 2) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors_mapping) +

    # Add p999 lines only for non-truncated traces
    geom_vline(data = data.frame(type = "Original trace", p999 = p999_original), 
               aes(xintercept = p999), color = "darkred", linetype = "dashed", size = 1.2) +
    geom_vline(data = data.frame(type = "Treated trace", p999 = p999_treated), 
               aes(xintercept = p999), color = "darkslategray", linetype = "dashed", size = 1.2) +
    # Add p100 (max) lines only for non-truncated traces
    geom_vline(data = data.frame(type = "Original trace", p100 = p100_original), 
               aes(xintercept = p100), color = "maroon", linetype = "dotted", size = 1.2) +
    geom_vline(data = data.frame(type = "Treated trace", p100 = p100_treated), 
               aes(xintercept = p100), color = "black", linetype = "dotted", size = 1.2) +

    # Add text labels for the lines (vertical orientation)
    geom_text(data = data.frame(type = "Original trace", p999 = p999_original, y_pos = 0), 
              aes(x = p999, y = y_pos, label = "P999"), 
              color = "darkred", vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.1, size = 3, fontface = "bold", angle = 90) +
    geom_text(data = data.frame(type = "Original trace", p100 = p100_original, y_pos = 0), 
              aes(x = p100, y = y_pos, label = "P100"), 
              color = "maroon", vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.1, size = 3, fontface = "bold", angle = 90) +
    geom_text(data = data.frame(type = "Treated trace", p999 = p999_treated, y_pos = 0), 
              aes(x = p999, y = y_pos, label = "P999"), 
              color = "darkslategray", vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.1, size = 3, fontface = "bold", angle = 90) +
    geom_text(data = data.frame(type = "Treated trace", p100 = p100_treated, y_pos = 0), 
              aes(x = p100, y = y_pos, label = "P100"), 
              color = "black", vjust = 1.5, hjust = -0.1, size = 3, fontface = "bold", angle = 90) +

    labs(title = paste("Histograms of Latencies for ", title),
         x = "Duration",
         y = "Frequency",
         caption = "Dashed lines: P999 | Dotted lines: P100 (Maximum values)") +

    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "none",  # Remove legend since facet titles show the info
          strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
          plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, hjust = 0.5))
}

compare_traces <- function(func_ref, title) {
  function_trace       = subset(inv2021,        func == func_ref)$duration
  function_merge_trace = subset(inv2021_merged, func == func_ref)$duration
  
  plot_unified_hist_facets_auto(function_trace, function_merge_trace, title)
}

save_individual_plots <- function(functions_to_plot, titles) {
  # Create plots directory if it doesn't exist
  if (!dir.exists("plots")) {
    dir.create("plots")
  }

  # Save each plot
  for (i in 1:length(functions_to_plot)) {
    plot_obj <- compare_traces(functions_to_plot[i], titles[i])
    print(plot_obj)
    
    # Save as PNG
    ggsave(
      filename = paste0( "plots/histogram_", substr(functions_to_plot[i], nchar(functions_to_plot[i])-2, nchar(functions_to_plot[i])),".png"),
      plot = plot_obj,
      width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300
    )
  }
}
```
